text:
Keisha Nolan: quick sync for the benchmark launch post + webinar hero. need a clean narrative: one headline, one metric pair, one microchart. who owns what?
Ethan Zhao: I can run the bench and provide normalized numbers. recommend headline metric = 95th latency + cost per 1k tokens. chart = 2-axis mini (95th ms left, $/1k right) with three lines (hosted/dedicated/private).
Marta Ruiz: I'll write the short copy: 1-line social headline, 2-line post body, 1-line CTA. keep it non-absolute (use "up to"). include a methodology blurb link.
Samir Patel: design will do hero variants (social, blog, slide). prefer left-aligned number pair + right-side mini chart. need CSV by EOD to replace placeholders.
Keisha Nolan: inbound routing: HubSpot form -> tag=bench-launch -> confirm email -> nurture sequence. Enterprise domains -> SDR queue. add hidden field "infra_interest" for routing.
Ethan Zhao: running microbench now (seq=512, batch auto, KV cache warm, int8 quant where supported). sample CSV I'll drop: "model,mode,median_ms,95pct_ms,cost_per_1k" then rows.
Ethan Zhao: sample placeholder: ```mistral-8b,hosted,24,92,0.90
mistral-8b,dedicated,18,68,0.62
mistral-8b,private,20,80,0.75
```
Marta Ruiz: draft social copy: "Launching inference benchmarks: see how serving choices move latency and token cost. Join our webinar to get the full playbook. Register: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench :rocket:"
Samir Patel: timeline check: data by today EOD, design mock by tomorrow AM, landing + email flow by Wed EOD, webinar rehearsal Friday.
deploy-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Benchmark Lab: Latency & Cost Playbook" 2026-04-14 11:00 PDT. Reg: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench
Keisha Nolan: editorial rules: no absolute claims on social; link to methodology with seq/batch/quant notes; call out "up to" language.
Ethan Zhao: will post final CSV and short explainer sentences for each tile here once run completes.
Marta Ruiz: agree on single takeaway: "95th latency vs $/1k". that'll be our hero number pair.
Keisha Nolan: perfect. we'll reconvene after Ethan posts the CSV. keep copy conservative and add footnote: "results vary by workload". :white_check_mark:
